PromptIndex__Meta.PromptIndex__Description: Manifest of every prompt record file held on disk. Each prompt is a standalone JSON object in its own file so records can be added, edited and version controlled individually. The app loads this manifest first, then fetches each listed record file. Add a new prompt by dropping the record file into the record path folder and adding one entry below.

PromptRecord__Meta.PromptRecord__Summary: One or two sentences describing what this prompt does and when to reach for it.
PromptRecord__Meta.PromptRecord__SubCategory: Sub category key taken from the parent category in the taxonomy file
PromptRecord__ModelTargets: Model target keys from the taxonomy file

PromptRecord__PromptText: The prompt body is stored as an array of lines so it stays readable and diff friendly in git.
An empty string produces a blank line.
Job specific values are written as double brace tokens such as {{VariableToken}} and are declared below.
A plain string is also accepted here if a single line prompt is all that is needed.

PromptRecord__Variables.Variable__Label: Field label shown on the compose form
PromptRecord__Variables.Variable__DefaultValue: Pre-filled value - use the proven original wording so an untouched form composes the known good prompt
PromptRecord__Variables.Variable__Placeholder: Greyed hint text shown in the empty field
PromptRecord__Variables.Variable__HelpText: Short note shown under the field
Variable__Options: Only used by the Select input type

PromptRecord__Usage.PromptRecord__Notes: Working notes - what it is good at, what it fails at, which model gave the best result.
